annotation.title_clean: Building trust in data and AI: the new Data and AI Ethics Framework and self-assessment tool
annotation.title_en: Building trust in data and AI: the new Data and AI Ethics Framework and self-assessment tool
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Government Digital Service (GDS), Responsible Data and AI team (Hess-Rheingans, E.; Hawkes, L.; Gilburt, B.)
annotation.summary_en: UK Government Digital Service blog post announcing the refreshed Data and AI Ethics Framework and a new self-assessment tool for public-sector data and AI projects. It expands principles to privacy, sustainability, societal impact and safety, and aligns with the AI Playbook and ATRS. It contains no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Data Ethics Framework renamed Data and AI Ethics Framework, with scope expanded to AI and algorithmic technologies
Principles expanded to include privacy, environmental sustainability, societal impact and safety alongside fairness, accountability and transparency
New self-assessment tool to identify risks and impacts across the project life cycle
Aligned with the AI Playbook, ATRS and Model for Responsible Innovation
Updated version planned for first half of 2026
